task.title: Prepare the Area
task.shortdesc: Make assembly easier and safer with a prepared area

step.cmd: Make sure your work area is clean, well lit, and has a non-conductive surface to work on. This will make finding dropped screws much easier, and prevent accidental electrostatic discharge from damaging your components while assembling. An electrostatic discharge wristband, which grounds your body so you don’t break sensitive electronics with a static shock, is nice to have but not strictly necessary as most components have a thin coating to mitigate static discharge. It’s under $10 on Amazon if you’re really worried though. You can also invest into an electrostatic dissipative mat and rubber soled shoes if you’re very concerned.
